tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phywa phrin nor bu'i chog rgyal sa lugs ltar gtong tshul 'dod dgu rab gsal bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis snyigs dus dbul phongs sel byed man ngag rin chen spungs pa'i ya gyal phywa phrin nor bu'i chog gzhung ldan lo tshul khrims rin chen gyis gsar ma ltar bkral ba'i bstan bcos 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs la/ sa lo yab sras kyi phyag len la bzhugs pa'i dbyangs rol sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas te nyams su len tshul ni/ thog mar mchod pa byin brlabs kyi shap+ta āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i rjes su/ bcom dung btang la rdo rje phur pa'i rol mo byin dbab bsdus pa'i bsdus pa/ bdag dang nas/ mchi bar la chos spyod/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma'i gdangs bcas lan gsum/ gdangs de nyid kyis sems bskyed lan gsum/ bdag bskyed la chos spyod bar gdangs/ sngags phreng 'khor sogs ci nus/ mchod bstod la phyag rgya las dril gsil rol mo mi dgos/ spyan ma'i sngags la mdzod rgya 'cha' bar gsungs kyang sngags de la de rang gi phyag rgya dang mdzod rgya sngags bcas so sor rnam sras kyi gzhung rnams na gsungs yod pas de bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed 'don tshul kyang bdag bskyed bzhin/ spyi bor mi bskyod mgon pos mtshan/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ rdor thal gyi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas gtor ma lan gsum bsngos/ mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i nyer mchod lnga'i mthar/ shap+tar rol chen bstod pa dang 'dod gsol la dril gsil gdangs bcas/ rgyal chen gyi gtor ma bsngos grub ma thag phyogs skyong gi gtor ma byin rlabs dang bsngos la/ bcom rol med par rnga brdung ste/ phywa khu ye nas/ skyobs shig gi bar la yang dag don 'du'i dbyangs dang mthar de'i rol mo/ de phyin la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung bcug la/ lho phyogs nas/ skyobs shig la rol mo bya dgos pas/ shig sbraṃ 123/ 123/

gcig ces gsum brdeg len can bsdus par bya/ nub dang byang la'ang de'i rigs 'gre/ steng nas bar snang rdzogs pa'i bar byas la rol mo gong bzhin/ phyogs mtshams kyi mthar yang rol mo gong bzhin byas la/ rnga rol bzhag 'di'i rol mo thams cad la sgang dung re re'o/ /bgegs gtor 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ ming sngags kyi mthar mdzod sngags btags pa nas gsum gyis bsngos la/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar dang / g.yon dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / hūm̐ 'dren bcug pa'i gang zhig mtshan mo'i gdangs/ the tshom med la rol mo khad kyis blangs te drag rol drag dung bcas gtor ma phyir dor/ gnas khang yungs kar gyis brab/ zhwa gyon gsum brdeg len can byas la/ shar nas skyobs shig gi bar la shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / byang sgo'i phreng bcol rdzogs pa'i skyabs su gsol la rol mo gong bzhin/ zhwa phud zhu chen gyi gsung rab ltar na bskyed chog la rnga mi brdung ba'i lugs mdzad kyang gyer sgam rigs kyi bskyed chog la rnga brdung yang 'gal ba gtan nas med pas/ phywa khu ye zhes lan gcig tu brjod la/ chos kun nas/ bh+rūm̐ḥzhes pa'i bar dpal ldan srid gsum ma'i dbyangs/ de nas rol mo mi len pa/ bh+rūm̐ ma wā ma wā ya 'od ces sogs tshig rkang gnyis la dbyangs gong bzhin bcug la rol mo sum brdeg len can/ de bzhin du sh+lau ka phyi ma gnyis la'ang dbyangs rol de dang 'dra ba/ de phyin sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung bcas nor bu nas/ gyur pa las la gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa byas la gcig lhag pa'i nyis brdeg len can 'phar ma bya/ bskyed chog sh+lau ka gcig la dbus su bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs rol tshar gnyis/ de phyin sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / phyir bzhugs la rol mo/ mgon po nas gong bzhin/ dkrugs gzhug la rol mo/ 'khor dang bcas nas gong bzhin/

rta la bcibs la rol mo/ pho brang nas gong bzhin/ gri bsnams la rol mo/ 'khor so so nas gong bzhin/ 'khod par gyur la rol mo byas te rnga rol bzhag rang gi snying ga nas sa mā dzaḥbar brjod bcom dung bcom rol rkang gling bcas dang rim bzhin lnga brdeg len can dgos pas lnga byas gcig ces mi 'dra ba'i khyad par tsam/ 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ bai e bai/ zhes sbyar la tshig rkang drug la dbyangs rol rkang gling bcas dang ring bzhin/ dbyangs so so'i 'gor 'dren gong bzhin/ de phyin sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / gsol la rol mo'i mthar chem brdung rkang gling sbraṃ gcig gnyis zhes rnga rol bzhag dzaḥnas sngon po bar brjod/ tad+ya thā/ hi li nas swāhā bar gsum/ oṃ bai shrā ba ṇa sogs dang / dzam bha la yab yum gyi sngags so so nas bdun re/ rta bdag brgyad sngags so so nas gsum re/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa byin brlabs/ bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len can lugs/ dri med nas/ mdzod bar gur drag bla med mchod pa'i dbyangs rol/ rnga brdung gi mchod sngags rnams kyang brjod/ shap+ta'i mthar/ hūm̐ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum/ zhes sogs gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa/ de phyir sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung sngags/ mtha'i hūm̐ thams cad la rol mo gong bzhin/ mchod phreng rgyas par byed na 'bring po 'di mi dgos pas rgyas pa'i maṇ+ḍal rdzogs pa'i hūm̐ rol mo bcas kyi mthar/ gcig lhag nyis brdeg len can 'phar ma bsgyur/ be we zhes sbyar la/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig la srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs dang gnyis brdeg len can/ de phyin sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung sde tshogs bcas la bstod la rol mo byas la rnga rol bzhag gtor ma byin brlabs chab gtor ltar byas la/ 'bul tshul gtso bo la lan gsum/ rta bdag brgyad kyi sngags lhan cig tu sbyar nas lan gsum/ aṣ+ṭā man lan gsum gyis bsngos/ bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len can/

hūm̐ ngo / sbyar la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo/ de phyin dbyangs thung grub par mdzod la rol mo/ rgyal chen gyis gtor ma bsngos/ rnga rol dbyangs thung lugs kyi phrin bcol rnga rol bzhag phyogs skyong yang rgyal chen bzhin la rol mo'i mthar gcig lhag gsum brdeg len can 'phar mar bsgyur/ phywa khu zhes bcad la/ ye bai zhes rgyangs/ sngon bskal sh+lau ka gcig la/ gang sku ma'i dbyangs tshar gnyis/ gsum brdeg len can re re/ de phyin kaṃ ka rda ra'i 'dur gdangs/ bkra shis dpal gyi gnas 'di ru'i mthar lha mchog ma'i mchod dbyangs thung ba bzhin/ de nas rnga 'phar brdung bcas/ rgyal chen 'khor bcas la tshig rol/ shar nas gong bzhin rlung g.yab la tshig rol/ mtshams nas gong bzhin tshe dang la tshig rol/ phywa khu ye zhes sbyar la/ dpal ldan mgon po nas/ bstod par la stong nyid ma'i bu dbyangs/ gsum brdeg len can gdung ba'i nas gong bzhin/ g.yang 'di la tshig rol/ phywa khu ye nas gong bzhin/ dgos 'dod char ltar gyi mthar/ tshe dang la tshig rol/ ngal gsos nas gong bzhin/ tshe dang la tshig rol/ klu yi nas gong bzhin/ tshe dang la tshig rol/ ring po nas gong bzhin/ tshe dang la tshig rol/ pho brang nas gong bzhin/ tshe dang la tshig rol/ lha dang nas gong bzhin/ tshe dang la tshig rol/ dus bzhi'i nas gong bzhin/ g.yang 'dir la tshig rol/ bdag mdun lha yi sh+lau ka gcig la klu rgyal gyi 'dur gdangs/ phywa khu ye nas/ nā ti'i mtha' yi g.yang 'di la tshig rol phywa khu ye zhes sbyar la/ nyi ma shar phyogs nas/ tshe dang dpal ni sogs kyi bar la gong bzhin klu rgyal gyi gdangs/ nyi ma lho phyogs nas rnga 'phar brdung byas dbus phyogs kyi mtha'i g.yang 'di la tshig rol gyi mthar gsum brdeg len can 'phar mar bsgyur la/ hūm̐ ngo / zhes sbyar te/ bdag mdun lha yi sh+lau ka gcig la bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs rol/ mkhyen brtse nas rnga 'phar brdung /

phyi nang la tshig rol/ phywa khu ye nas gong bzhin/ sbyin bdag dpal kun la tshig rol/ phyi nang nas gong bzhin/ sbyin bdag dpal ni la tshig rol/ rigs bzang nas gong bzhin/ sbyin bdag dpal ni la tshig rol/ sra zhing nas/ gong bzhin/ sbyin bdag dpal ni la tshig rol/ 'pho 'gyur nas gong bzhin/ 'phel zhing rtag tu la tshig rol gyi mthar chems brdung sgang dung gsum brdeg len bcas byas la rnga rol bzhag rgyal chen gyi thugs ka nas khengs par gyur par brjod la/ gzungs ring 'ur 'don nyer gcig gam phreng 'khor sogs rnam sras snying po dang / dzam+bha la yab yum gyi sngags rnams so sor nas brgya stong sogs ci 'grub shub bu gal te stong bzlas na/ rta bdag brgyad so sor phreng 'khor/ phreng 'khor bzlas na rta bdag brgyad la bcu gcig re 'ur 'don/ rgyal po nas/ stsal du gsol gyi bar me tog 'thor ba dang bcas lan gsum/ zhag sgrub byed mi byed kyi dbye ba dang tshogs ni gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin/ gnod sbyin zhal gso ltar na lhag ma ma byung kyang chog chad mdo dang bstan skyong ni 'dir bdag bskyed phyag rdor gos sngon byas pa'i dbang du btang bas mi dgos/ rang lugs yang phur gur drag sogs kyi bdag bskyed byas na gzhung de rnams nas 'byung ba'i tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum lhag ma bstan skyong rnams bya dgos/ phywa sgos byed pa'i tshe sbyin bdag drung du 'bod pa'i ma bos kyang chog gong ltar bzlas pa'i mtha'i 'dod gsol gsum po de rdzogs pa dang / zhwa gyon bcom dung btang rol mo bcom la/ chems brdung 'phar chung gsum/ che dal ba gsum myur ba gnyis/ yang de 'dra gnyis/ bco lnga brdeg gcig cho gnyis byas la/ phywa khu ye zhes sbyar la/ rgyal po nas sa bdag ma'i dbyangs bcug la/ g.yang 'di la dzar dang rol mo de'i las mkhan lugs/ phywa khu ye nas rnga 'phar brdung / byang sgo'i mtha'i sbyin bdag la tshig rol gyi mthar gsum brdeg len can 'phar ma bsgyur la/

hūm̐ bdag dang lha yi sogs bstod tshul gong bzhin sbyin bdag yod na/ rdzas bskyed nas/ 'o khyed rnams nas/ mdzod bar slob dpon gyis brjod/ sbyin bdag med na mtshams sbyor 'dir mi dgos/ gang ltar dril gsil ma lus sems can ma'i gdangs thung ba bcas/ phywa khu ye bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas nas/ byin gyis rlobs kyi mthar/ mchod rol sgang dung sngags brjod la bzhag phywa bum brtag rgyal srid sna bdun la gdangs med/ khaṅga rat+na sogs kyi mthar bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha'i bkra shis brjod la/ mi dbang 'khor lo sogs/ lo brgya 'tsho zhing sogs/ bkra shis kyi tshig ci rigs brjod pa'i mthar rol chen/ tshogs gong bzhin/ mjug chog ni rtogs sla'o/ /zhes sde dge zhu chen rin po che'i phywa gzhung gsung rab rang re'i nyams su len tshul 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod 'od do/ /yang 'di'i bdag bskyed rdo rje phur pa byed na/ gshoms kyi skabs su phur gtor lnga/ sman raka de dang rjes 'brel gtor bsngo bskang ba byed na dam rdzas bcu tshar nas gcig gi bar gang rigs dang / bkra shis bskang / bsdus bskang / sras mchog rigs lnga'i phur pa yungs dkar bcas dang / nub rjes mar dgos pa'i tshogs tha ma'i yo byad rnams 'dus byas dngos gzhi gnas yo byin brlabs nas rig 'dzin bskul rdzogs pa'i bar gyis bdag mdun dang / de nas yi dam chos srung gi gtor bsngo bskang ba rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar/ lhor gru/ bkra shis/ smon lam bkra shis rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ phywa glud/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phywa glud ces pa nas/ brtan byed kyi bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar gzhug bzhin mchod pa/ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta dang / swa bhā wa bsangs sbyangs gong gi rigs 'gre sbyar la/

dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin/ tshogs byin brlabs/ spyan 'dren 'bul bshags spyi bstabs srid zhi dpal 'byor ma nas deng 'dir stsol bar/ gzhug chog gi mchod par/ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta dang / swa bhā wa bsangs sbyangs nas/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swāhā'i bar gong bzhin/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams gzhung bzhin dang / ye shes lnga ldan nas bkra shis rdzogs pa'i bar phyag len bzhin/ nyin rjes mar bsgral mchod rdzogs nas phywa sgo dbye la slob dpon sbyin bdag dang bcas pa tshogs la rol la lhag ma bsdus la/ sbyin bdag rnams gyes/ slob dpon rnams kyis lhag la rgyas par btang / spyi btab phyir byed na phud gtor lnga dang / dam rdzas/ bkra shis bskang / bsdus bskang / bstan skyong gi gtor ma phud chang rnams thog khar bshams la pu tra bskul/ spyi btabs/ bstan skyong srid zhi dpal 'byor ma rnams byas nas nang du log ste/ rnam sras mchod bstod bzung bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin dang / spyi btab nang du byed na lhag ma rdzogs gral spyi btab bstan skyong sogs bya'o// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ phywa phrin nor bu'i chog rgyal sa lugs ltar gtong tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
